The '''Poppyseed Muffin''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients as well as wheat flour and sugar from the [[Mill]].  

Poppyseed Muffin can be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]], a gift from [[Krobus]] if he is your roommate, or bought at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|250}}.

==Bundles==
Poppyseed Muffin is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Poppyseed Muffin is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|White Dot Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt273.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Poppyseed Muffin is not used in any [[quests]].
